description: Domain Scan by CYBERACE checks a domain's email, HTTPS and DNS security, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, TLS certificates, security headers, DNSSEC and blocklists. Get a security score, per-check findings and suggested fixes, with a temporary report link when available. No account or API key is required. Each scan stores results, consumes scan quota and may trigger administrative notifications. This plugin provides on-demand public domain scans; it does not access account data, configure monitoring or modify DNS records.

defaultPrompt: Scan example.com and explain its domain security issues.
Check example.com for SPF, DKIM and DMARC problems.
Check example.com’s DNSSEC configuration and blocklist status.
